उच्छिख

UCCHIKHA . A serpent born in the family of takṣaka. It was burnt to death at Janamejaya's serpent yajña. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 57, Verse 9).

उच्छृंग

UCCHṚṄGA . One of the two attendants given to skanda by vindhya. The other was named atiśṛṅga. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 45, Verse 49).
